Image Description: The image depicts a pastoral scene featuring two Holstein Friesian cows in a grassy field. The cow in the foreground is facing the camera directly, standing on a well-maintained green pasture. It has a predominantly white coat with large black patches, characteristic of the breed, and its ears are tagged, likely for identification purposes. A green collar or band is visible around one of its front legs. The cow appears calm and alert, with its head slightly tilted forward.
